title.narrative: Basic Education, Access, Mgmt Support Phase I
Educacin Bsica, Acceso y Apoyo Administrativo Fase I

description.narrative: BEAMS is a multi-phase operation with total loan financing of US$50 million. Program objectives include: (i) strengthened MOE capacity to sustain improved literacy and numeracy attainment in the basic education cycle, particularly in underserved poverty areas; and (ii) increasedsecondary access. Phase I will focus on improved student performance, human resource development, MOE management systems, and limited school construction. Phase II will continue the works program.
